themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Across Europe, right-wing and far-right parties are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, proposing measures to restrict voting rights, prioritize national citizens in social services, and reduce foreign aid. This theme appears prominently in Norway, Spain, Sweden, and the UK, reflecting a shared transnational agenda.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes revoking local voting rights for foreign citizens, affecting 360,000 residents, including 70,000 Poles.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands prioritization of national citizens in social services and housing, and criticizes government spending on immigrants.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and expansion of repatriation grants to include naturalized citizens.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes criminalizing non-English election materials and prioritizing UK citizens in social services.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Calls for stricter asylum policies and opposes multiculturalism, linking immigration to crime and social issues.

themes.title: Iran threatens Western leaders amid escalating tensions
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right media across multiple countries are amplifying narratives of Iranian aggression and threats to Western leaders. This theme is driven by U.S. strikes on Iran, Iran's nuclear ambitions, and regional conflicts involving Iran-backed militias, resonating strongly in the U.S., Italy, France, and the UK.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration escalates military actions against Iran, including strikes on nuclear sites and threats to impose fees in the Strait of Hormuz.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Covers Italy's role in regional security amid U.S.-Iran tensions, including Meloni's diplomatic engagements in the Middle East.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Highlights France's stance on Iran, including concerns over nuclear threats and regional instability.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes UK government's handling of Iran-related threats and calls for stronger security measures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Frames Iran as a security threat to Spain and Europe, advocating for stronger defense policies.

themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders across Europe and the U.S. are confronting legal troubles, political setbacks, and internal party conflicts. This theme is evident in France, Spain, Hungary, the UK, and the U.S., where leaders like Marine Le Pen, Santiago Abascal, Viktor Orbán, Nigel Farage, and Donald Trump face corruption charges, electoral defeats, or internal dissent.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen faces corruption charges and legal battles while running for president in 2027.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal and party members face legal scrutiny over corruption allegations and misuse of public funds.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Viktor Orbán's government faces constitutional crises, internal dissent, and EU legal challenges over democratic backsliding.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage faces scrutiny over political donations, security threats, and internal party conflicts.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump faces multiple lawsuits, including defamation cases and investigations into election interference.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s economic reforms spark global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei is becoming a global icon for right-wing and libertarian movements, with his economic reforms—such as central bank restructuring, deregulation, and fiscal austerity—being closely watched and emulated by right-wing leaders in the U.S., Spain, the UK, and Italy. This theme reflects a transnational fascination with Milei’s radical economic policies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei's government pushes for radical economic reforms, including central bank restructuring, deregulation, and fiscal austerity.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration and allies praise Milei’s reforms, particularly his deregulation and anti-inflation measures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders express admiration for Milei’s economic policies and seek to emulate his deregulation agenda in Spain.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage and Reform UK cite Milei’s reforms as a model for the UK’s economic future.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties discuss adopting Milei-style economic policies, particularly fiscal austerity and deregulation.

themes.title: Right-wing parties clash over electoral reforms
themes.blurb: Electoral reforms are a contentious issue among right-wing parties in Europe, particularly in Italy, Hungary, Spain, and Poland. These debates center on voting systems, preferential voting, and constitutional amendments, often leading to internal dissent and political crises within governing coalitions.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni’s government faces internal dissent over electoral law reforms, with allies rejecting preferential voting proposals.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary’s ruling party pushes constitutional amendments to remove the president, sparking political crises and opposition backlash.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox clashes with coalition partners over electoral reforms, including deficit targets and budget priorities.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal divisions over electoral strategies and constitutional reforms, particularly regarding EU relations.
